readme: Gold cases for scripts/eval-match.ts. Each case: { age:int, feeling:string, expect:figureKey|"miss", note?:string }. Hard near-miss cases add { hard:true, plausibleWrong:figureKey, confusionGroup:string } so confusion is computable. expect:"miss" means NO figure fits — the case passes if framing comes back "partial" (an honest 'fragment that rhymes'), regardless of which figure is named. NOTE on library shape: with only 3 age-clustered figures (douglass ~20-23, butler ~26-28, lee ~50-54) and a +/-10y age gate, the only intra-pool confusable pair is butler<->douglass; lee is age-isolated and has no confusion partner until a similarly-aged figure is authored. The miss cases are deliberately age-in-range so they exercise the reranker's confidence calibration, not just the age gate. Expand this set as the library grows; a high top-1 with few hard pairs is unproven, not validated — weight authoring effort on hard confusionGroup cases. Paraphrase/metaphor cases carry { semantic:true }: low literal keyword overlap, EXPECTED to elude the keyword prefilter (so they're exempt from its survival assertion) and to be retrieved only by FacetsRAG — the keyword-vs-facetsrag head-to-head signal. Run keyword vs facetsrag (RETRIEVAL_MODE) and diff summary.json: FacetsRAG-positive = top-1 >= keyword AND hard/semantic confusion drops.
